canonical_project: Centrul de Date Regional Sud-Muntenia (Calarasi participation)
owner: Serviciul de Telecomunicatii Speciale (STS) with Calarasi County Council among partners
notes: Official Calarasi County Council project page (SMIS 342697, PR SM 2021-2027) lists STS in partnership with the county councils of Arges, Calarasi, Dambovita, Giurgiu, Ialomita, Prahova and Teleorman implementing the South-Muntenia Regional Data Center. Total budget 236.4 million lei, implementation July 2025 - December 2028. The physical data center facility is to be built in Prahova county, Ploiesti; Calarasi is a partner county for digital services migration (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS for local public authorities).
